proposedConvention.name: scene
proposedConvention.meaning: A named pose family of a decorative effect, optionally evaluated at consumer-supplied local progress.
proposedConvention.whenToUse: Select a decorative effect's supported camera, assembly or explosion scene; scene names are component-specific.
proposedConvention.avoid: Engine parameter presets (use effect-profile), Material treatments, page choreography, task progress or lifecycle state.

convention.name: scene
convention.meaning: A named pose family of a decorative effect, optionally evaluated at consumer-supplied local progress.
convention.whenToUse: Select a decorative effect's supported camera, assembly or explosion scene; scene names are component-specific.
convention.avoid: Engine parameter presets (use effect-profile), Material treatments, page choreography, task progress or lifecycle state.

proposedConvention.name: progress
proposedConvention.meaning: Consumer-supplied normalized local progress used to evaluate a decorative effect scene.
proposedConvention.whenToUse: Drive a decorative pose or assembly curve independently of how the consumer derives its progress; normalization is component-specific.
proposedConvention.avoid: Task-completion or measurement semantics, accessible progress indicators, internal elapsed time or an uncontrolled user selection.

proposedConvention.name: pointerTilt
proposedConvention.meaning: Whether a decorative effect may apply a bounded pointer-relative tilt when its motion and input policy permits it.
proposedConvention.whenToUse: Let a consumer disable decorative pointer tilt; eligible pointer types, scenes, bounds and reduced-motion behavior are component-specific.
proposedConvention.avoid: Drag or selection interactions, keyboard behavior, arbitrary transforms, general animation toggles or bypassing reduced motion.
